diagram_math_checks.result: Y is the given proper complex variety and Y0,Y1,Y2 are the smooth projective hypercover levels of F1 and step 1.1. The augmentation a0 has domain Y0 and codomain Y. From Y1 to Y0 there are precisely d0,d1; from Y2 to Y1 there are d0,d1,d2. Their arrows point toward lower simplicial degree, as required by the supplier thm-proper-varieties-admit-smooth-projective-hyperresolutions F3 and construction step 4.1. The caption explicitly omits degeneracies and higher levels.

A face di:Y(p+1)->Yp induces di*:H^q(Yp;Q)->H^q(Y(p+1);Q), so the lower arrows reverse the geometric arrows. The p=0 differential is d0*-d1*, and p=1 is d0*-d1*+d2*, matching the alternating-face first differential in thm-proper-hypercovers-compute-constructible-derived-cohomology step 5.1 and this item step 1.1. Simplicial identities make successive alternating sums compose to zero; no exactness or extra commutative square is asserted.

For each fixed q>=0 the lower objects are E1^(p,q)=H^q(Yp;Q), p=0,1,2. F4 and step 1.1 give pure weight q for all three, while their total degrees are q,q+1,q+2. F3, the exact supplier lemma part (ii), and step 1.1 identify Gr_q^W H^n with E2^(n-q,q). Nonnegative cosimplicial degree gives q<=n, not q>=n or strict inequality. No splitting of H^n or degeneration at E1 is claimed.

The diagram concerns the proper hypercover construction only. Cohomology uses pullback (step 3.1), not proper pushforward. The separate homological class-map clause uses h_* followed by Poincare duality and the Tate twist (d), with weight -i before untwisting and 2d-i afterward, exactly as untouched step 4.1 states. The picture makes no extra smooth-open or class-map claim. The complete original Statement, Facts, proof and original Remarks are an exact byte prefix, so no inference relies on the new figure.
